about: Training loss of weights on training frames by tools/train_fit.py, no gradient: `training` with every layer as in training, `evaluation` with no dropout and batch-norm on its running statistics, as the model predicts. The lower loss fits the training frames closer; a loss that is higher in `evaluation` than in `training` says the weights lean on their training mode. Any other row switches one kind of layer alone, a state no run is in.
